name: Himeshima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Himeshima village emblem in white: a ring of five stylised letters C.
history: Municipal flag of Himeshima, a village in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1976.

features.role: Himeshima village emblem — a ring of five stylised letters C
